This implies a potential pathway where Acebutolol may influence the activity of Cyp2d6 through its interaction with Oxprenolol. The lowest common ancestor of Acebutolol and Oxprenolol, both belonging to the Beta-Adrenergic Antagonist class, suggests a shared pharmacological profile that could mediate the interaction between Acebutolol and Cyp2d6. The integrated explanation highlights the role of Oxprenolol as a mediator in the relationship between Acebutolol and Cyp2d6, emphasizing the importance of the beta-adrenergic pathway in this context.
